angle.hook: BitCraft Online leaves Early Access after 18 months with version 1.0 and a fresh world, at AED 32.25 on the UAE Steam store until 20 Nov
angle.why_now: version 1.0 went live on Steam on 13 Nov; the introductory offer on the UAE store ends 20 Nov
angle.what_it_means_here: UAE players see the introductory price AED 32.25 (AED 43 normally) on their own Steam store; no Arabic interface
angle.payoff: price and the offer end date on the strip; the game has no Arabic
